title: Writing Task 1 - Table: Electricity Generation
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a table showing electricity generation by source in five countries.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Electricity Generation by Source — Five Countries (2022)
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The table below shows the percentage of electricity generated from different sources in five countries in 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data (Coal / Gas / Nuclear / Renewables / Other): France: 3% / 9% / 71% / 14% / 3%. Germany: 28% / 15% / 6% / 46% / 5%. Australia: 52% / 21% / 0% / 24% / 3%. Brazil: 1% / 9% / 2% / 85% / 3%. China: 61% / 3% / 5% / 28% / 3%.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the table showing electricity generation by source across five countries in 2022.

keyFeatures: France was dominated by nuclear power (71%), the highest proportion of any single source
Brazil generated 85% of its electricity from renewables, far exceeding other nations
China and Australia were the most reliant on coal (61% and 52% respectively)
Germany was the only country with a near-equal split between fossil fuels and renewables
